body:
> PKI – A PKI is an arrangement that binds public keys with respective identities of entities. The binding is established through a process of registration and issuance of certificates at and by a certificate authority (CA).

vs

> PKI – A Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) is an arrangement that binds public keys with respective identities of entities. The binding is established through a process of registration and issuance of certificates at and by a certificate authority (CA).
title: Appendix A - PKI - Explain what the abbreviation stands for
